story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: Existing functionality identifies inbound Eligibility Date, Assessment Date, and Maintenance Date for transaction-effective-date selection
gaps: Scenario condition missing: "5) First occurrence of repeated Maintenance Date values in the inbound file is used." Most closely related test case: "TC_001"; add a dedicated test case for it.
Scenario condition missing: "4) First occurrence of repeated Eligibility Date values in the inbound file is used." Most closely related test case: "TC_002"; add a dedicated test case for it.

flagged.why: flow is compressed below required depth

gaps: TC_002 has 12 steps, below minimum 18 stated in hint. Counted steps in Test Case Id 'TC_002' are 1 through 12. Contradicts hint: 'Every test case walks the complete end-to-end flow at full atomic depth - file creation with the resolved literal file name, staging, pickup, archive, TM UI verification with status values, canonical file and GUID validation, FACETS SQL validation, and the Facets client lookup - at 18 steps minimum; do not compress the flow in any case.'

scenarios.title: Current eligibility with Assessment Date changed uses Assessment Date as transaction effective date
gaps: TC_002 has 10 steps counted from Step # values "1" through "10"; hint says "Every test case walks the complete end-to-end flow at full atomic depth - file creation with the resolved literal file name, staging, pickup, archive, TM UI verification with status values, canonical file and GUID validation, FACETS SQL validation, and the Facets client lookup - at 18 steps minimum; do not compress the flow in any case."

Scenario condition is uncovered: "2) Current eligibility with Assessment Date changed and other non-listed data elements also change still uses Assessment Date because the story rule is keyed to Assessment Date change." TC_002 also requires "at least one additional non-listed data element changed in the same transaction" to be verified after processing, not only introduced in file setup; add a dedicated test case for it.
